Inside Title-Desk, Artificial Landman & the Title-Desk Agent

Why two sister platforms tie for the #1 spot in Texas mineral title research — and how multi-model cross-family browser verification and independent workbook readback pair with local $0 Tesseract OCR and deterministic BigInt fraction arithmetic on the desktop.

1. Why Title-Desk & Artificial Landman Tie for #1 Overall

Every rival in our 24-tool study automates at most half of the mineral-title production chain — leaving either courthouse reading, exact rational fraction math, or client deliverables unresolved.

The Browser Examination Engine (Title-Desk & Artificial Landman)

Both title-desk.com and artificiallandman.io execute the exact same Texas-specific hosted verification pipeline:

  • Free Pre-Payment Scope Check: Validates Texas county, abstracts/surveys, gross acreage, and internal packet consistency before charging a cent.
  • Examiner Model 1 (Chain Builder): Reads every recorded instrument and builds the chronological chain of title with exact Vol/Page or Document # citations.
  • Examiner Model 2 (Independent Ownership Examiner): Independently works all conveyances, reservations, Duhig steps, double fractions, and pre/post-Sept. 1, 1993 Texas community-property intestacy splits.
  • Cross-Family Validator (Model 3) & Readback Gate: An independent third model from a separate provider inspects the final answer against the scanned page images, giving the examiner one repair pass and keeping any still-unresolved tract as a proposal leading the curative requirements; an independent reader then reopens the written .xlsx file and stops delivery on any mismatch.
  • Four-Sheet Excel Deliverable: Outputs Summary, Ownership, Runsheet, and Title Review — explicitly naming any referenced prior deed missing from the upload packet.

The Local Workstation: Title-Desk Agent (desktop.title-desk.com)

For working landmen, title attorneys, and brokerages managing multi-tract units, rural courthouse photo archives, and strict operator deliverable specs:

  • $0 Local Tesseract OCR + Multi-Page TIFF Rendering: Runs locally via Tesseract + @napi-rs/canvas in the main process — zero cloud per-page OCR charges on 2,000-page archives.
  • Deterministic BigInt Exact-Fraction Math: LLMs never touch arithmetic. Every conveyance is computed as exact BigInt numerators/denominators (1/3 + 1/3 + 1/3 = 1/1 exact) with automatic tract balance checks.
  • Human Propose → Accept Gates: Extracted instruments remain inert proposals until a human examiner accepts them; unbacked report rows trigger NOT READY TO ISSUE.
  • BYO Portals & BYO AI: Connects to your CountyRecords.com, CourthouseDirect, and TexasFile accounts plus Texas RRC data, using ChatGPT/Codex, Claude, API keys, or air-gapped local Ollama.
  • Multi-Client Deliverables & Billing: Exports custom Excel/Word reports, builds numbered client folder trees, and tracks time/expenses to the exact cent.

3. Reproducible 10-Assignment Desktop Pipeline Verification

Measured end-to-end across ten synthetic title assignments exercising clean takeoffs, 5-tract units, Duhig over-conveyances, broken chains, 3-way heirship splits, HBP wells, shortfalls, and multi-client deliverables (saving 17.6 manual hours across 33 compact test files).

Benchmark Assignment Title Defect / Scenario Exercised Verified System Outcome
1. Clean Mineral Takeoff One 640-acre Texas tract, sovereign patent plus one conveyance Baseline runsheet + exact NMA
2. Multi-Tract Drilling Unit Five separate tracts, each carrying an independent chain of title Tract-isolated mineral ownership
3. Duhig Over-Conveyance Grantor conveys a larger fraction than held while reserving an interest Caught automatically; both figures surfaced for human ruling
4. Broken Chain / Stranger to Title Instrument executed by a party with no prior vesting link in the chain Flagged explicitly rather than silently bridged
5. Three-Way Probate / Heirship Estate split 1/3 + 1/3 + 1/3 across three heirs BigInt rational ledger sums to exact 1/1 (zero float drift)
6. Leasehold & HBP Survival Oil & gas lease past primary term joined against producing RRC well Lease + RRC production status joined
7. Out-of-Balance Tract (3/4 Accounted) Chain accounts for 75% of the mineral estate 25% shortfall stated prominently on report
8. Strict Source-Citation Gate Ownership figure entered without an accepted source deed Stamped NOT READY TO ISSUE — UNSUPPORTED SOURCE REQUIRED
9. Client A Custom Deliverable 6-column Excel Due Diligence Report + DDR / OPINIONS folder tree Generated with zero code changes
10. Client B Custom Deliverable 2-column Word Ownership Summary + numbered 01/02 folder tree Same project data exported into second client spec
